tests.title: AC-16102-3: rcf verify run in its default agent mode spawns the agent session with RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0, so the project's feedback Stop hook exits 0 silently inside it, a pending --ask-now entry stays pending, and the report carries the agent's findings instead of LAUNCH-FAILURE
AC-16103-4: an entry rcf feedback add records in a linked git worktree is still listed pending by rcf feedback list from the main checkout after git worktree remove

AC-16103-4: a queue a linked worktree already holds is moved into the main checkout by the next rcf feedback command run there, and after git worktree remove every entry, old and new, is listed from the main checkout exactly once with the status it had

AC-16103-4: when the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/ (the worktree branch does), rcf feedback add in a linked worktree refuses as AC-15501-2 refuses, names the main checkout, and writes nothing under either checkout
AC-16103-4: when the main checkout does not hold the rcf project (adopted on the worktree branch only), rcf feedback add in a linked worktree never leaves a file the main checkout would commit
AC-16103-4: while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/, a linked worktree that holds a queue keeps listing its own held entries with the status they had, and nothing moves
AC-16103-4: while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/, the Stop hook in a linked worktree that holds a queue keeps asking about its held pending entries, and nothing moves

AC-16103-4: while the main checkout does not ignore .rcf/feedback/, rcf feedback add in a linked worktree that holds a queue exits 2 naming the main checkout, rcf doctor --fix and that the held entries move once it ignores the store, and nothing moves

AC-16103-4 guard: once the main checkout ignores .rcf/feedback/, the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree that held its queue while it did not moves that queue, and after git worktree remove every entry is listed from the main checkout once with the status it had

AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails, rcf feedback add in a linked worktree exits non-zero naming the error and the main checkout, writes nothing to the worktree queue and removes nothing it held

AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails after appending to the main queue, rcf feedback add in a linked worktree exits 1 naming the error and the main checkout, the worktree keeps every file it held, the main checkout lists each id once, and the next command completes the move with each id once

AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails after removing some held files, rcf feedback list in a linked worktree exits 1 naming the error and the main checkout, every removed held file has its content in the main store, every file still held is byte-identical, and the next command completes the move with each id once

AC-16103-4 guard: when the main checkout already holds the same entries.jsonl, state.json and outbox bundles (from the SessionEnd hook and from submit) as a linked worktree, the next rcf feedback command there removes every held file and copies nothing twice

AC-16103-4 guard: when the main checkout holds a state.json of its own, the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree merges every held ask record into the main state.json once and keeps every ask record the main checkout had

AC-16103-4: when the main checkout outbox already holds the name of each held bundle (the SessionEnd and the submit fallback bundle) with different bytes, the next rcf feedback command in a linked worktree exits 0, keeps each held bundle under a fresh name in the main outbox, leaves each main bundle byte-identical and removes every held file

AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails after removing a held bundle whose name the main outbox already holds with different bytes, rcf feedback list in a linked worktree exits 1 naming the error and the main checkout, every held byte stays readable from one of the two checkouts, and the next command completes the move with each held bundle once in the main outbox

AC-16103-4: when moving the held queue fails on a held bundle whose name the main outbox already holds with different bytes, rcf feedback list in a linked worktree exits 1 and keeps that bundle readable, and the next command completes the move with its bytes exactly once in the main outbox, never copied under a second name
AC-17302-14: rcf define create ac --parent <US> --from-file <json> keeps the scope the file carries on the written criterion
AC-17302-14: rcf define create ac --parent <US> --description <text> --from-file <json> keeps the scope the file carries (CLI fields merged over the file)
AC-17302-14: a same-id replay (rcf define create ac --id) of a criterion that carries scope, with identical content, is unchanged (exit 0) and does not rewrite the file

AC-19001-7: rcf verify run --url <url> --out <existing directory> (with or without a trailing slash) exits 2 with "--out must be a file path, not a directory" before any request reaches the target and writes nothing in the directory
AC-19001-7: rcf verify run --help describes --out as a file path and says a directory is refused (exit 2)
